title: Price, quantity, shipping
prompt: Three parameters this time. Return the total cost: the price times the quantity, plus shipping.
signature: func solve(price: float, quantity: int, shipping: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(price: float, quantity: int, shipping: float) -> float:
	return 0.0
hint: Multiplication happens before addition, so you may not need brackets.
solution:
func solve(price: float, quantity: int, shipping: float) -> float:
	return price * quantity + shipping
